name: Mistral Small 4
short: Mistral AI's compact multimodal MoE model unifying instruct chat, reasoning, and agentic coding with configurable reasoning effort.
modalities: Text and image in; text and code out
pricingNote: $0.15 / $0.60 per 1M input/output tokens ($0.015 cached read; Mistral AI La Plateforme and OpenRouter)
standout: An open Apache 2.0 MoE hybrid that combines chat, reasoning (Magistral) and agentic coding (Devstral) in one compact model.
tradeoff: Reasoning and coding indices measure well below frontier; no verified long-context retrieval scores at 256K.
